messages:
sam (partner-ops): FYI starting onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure listing for 'Redwood Hosted' SaaS + AMI. Need to align on account mapping, entitlements, and legal artifacts. Can we sync on roles/creds by EOD?

maria (eng): @sam I can do AWS AMI packaging checklist. Need an account with publisher IAM role + S3 access. What's the publisher account id?

sam (partner-ops): It's 123456789012 for AWS sandbox. For GCP/azure we'll use pub-rlw-sandbox. I'll DM creds.

jon (product): Two questions: 1) trial entitlements (14d vs 30d) vary by marketplace — we should pick a default. 2) SKU naming: prefer REDWOOD-SaaS-Standard / REDWOOD-AMI-Enterprise? Thoughts?

elaine (legal): We'll need localized EULA per region (EU/US) and the AMS CLD cert. Also contract clause for data-in-transit if customer-provided models. I'll start templates; need official product description.

maria (eng): For AMI, share the manifest with AMI IDs + region mapping. Also confirm whether we support VPC peering or customer-provided networking.

sam (partner-ops): Networking: support both; for initial listing we'll document "Bring-your-own-VPC" instructions. @maria I'll upload manifest by tomorrow.

deploy-bot: marketplace-staging created: https://console.marketplace/staging/listings/rlw-1234 (staging id: rlw-stg-2026)

sam (partner-ops): ok owners: @maria AMI manifest + packaging (due 2026-03-27), @jon SKU + trial policy (due 2026-03-25), @elaine EULA + contracts (due 2026-03-26). Ping me with blockers.

jon (product): noted. I'll propose default 14d trial and map 30d for partner co-markets. will post SKU mapping here.

elaine (legal): also requesting a copy of telemetry/data retention doc. pls attach.

maria (eng): attached sample manifest snippet:
```json
{"ami_map": {"us-east-1": "ami-0abcd1234", "us-west-2": "ami-0efgh5678"}, "build_tag": "2026-03-24-rc1"}
```

sam (partner-ops): thanks. quick sync tomorrow 10am PST?
